title.en: Fable 23 — The Fox and the Crow

sentences.en: A crow held a piece of cheese in his beak.
He sat on a high branch.

sentences.ar: الثعلب شافه وقال: يا أحلى طير!
sentences.en: The fox saw him and said: what a beautiful bird!
Your voice must be lovelier than your feathers.
The crow was pleased and opened his beak to sing.
The cheese fell and the fox took it.

sentences.ar: دير بالك من اللي بيمدحك كتير.
sentences.en: Beware of the one who praises you too much.
